_doc: The Ashwinter chapter 5. Hand-made (tools/maps/build_ashwinter_maps.py). The clans come down from the snow in the north-west; Highmere, the Concord's richest store-city, stands behind the Pale River in the south-east, with the granary towns of Harrowby and Millstead outside it. Both sides are capped at tier 5. Laid out on a 30x22 grid and drawn 3.3x larger.
name: The Granary of Highmere
